changes.title: No crawl
items: Walking north or south, grass, flowers and trees no longer flicker a pixel back and forth
Which of two overlapping things is drawn on top no longer depends on where the camera is

changes.title: Music load
items: The music now asks much less of your computer while you play, which should stop it crunching and cutting out on some laptops; it sounds the same

changes.title: Pile trousers
items: Putting on a jacket or top at the wardrobe no longer puts your trousers on too: trousers go on at the shoe rack, and until then her nightie shows under the jacket
With her trousers on but not her top, she wears her nightie over her jeans
